note: [L] proves the explicit formula for primitive `χ ≠ 1` (`explicit_formula_gen`) and for ζ with the main term `M(1)x` (`explicit_formula_zeta`), as limits over rectangles with the remainder an integral on Re s = -1/2 instead of a trivial-zero sum; imprimitive characters are not covered.

snippet.text:
theorem explicit_formula_zeta {φ : ℝ → ℂ} {K c : ℝ} (hφ : GoodSmoothing φ K c) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    ∃ T : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k : ℕ, T k ∈ Icc ((k : ℝ) + 1) ((k : ℝ) + 2)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun k => ∑ u ∈ zerosRectD zetaF (T k), (multRectD zetaF (T k) u : ℂ) *
          (mellin φ u * (x : ℂ) ^ u)) atTop
        (𝓝 (mellin φ 1 * x - SsumG (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) φ x -
          (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * ∫ y : ℝ, hZeta φ x (((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I))) := by

proof_context.conclusion: The trivial-character case: the same formula with the extra main term `mellin φ 1 * x` (the bracket `η̂(-δ)x`).
